recognize_zh: 鼻腔分泌物抹片中布滿大量顆粒性白血球，多數為雙葉或偏位核、細胞質帶粉橘色顆粒的嗜酸性球，背景是淡紫色黏液絲，大量嗜酸性球符合過敏性鼻炎。
features: Numerous granulocytes, many with bilobed or eccentric dense nuclei
Cytoplasm with pink-orange granular staining consistent with eosinophils
Cells scattered singly and in small clusters
Mucoid, fibrillary pale purple background with a few epithelial/degenerated cells
Image is at low magnification with limited focus, so individual granules are not crisply resolved
describe_en: Smear of nasal secretions shows numerous granulocytes dispersed singly and in small clusters within a mucoid fibrillary background. Most cells have bilobed or eccentric nuclei and cytoplasm with pink-orange granular staining consistent with eosinophils; granule detail is limited at this magnification. Few epithelial cells are present. Findings are consistent with nasal eosinophilia, supporting allergic rhinitis in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: Neutrophils have multilobed nuclei and pale lilac cytoplasm without orange granules and are often accompanied by bacteria.
NARES shows the same nasal eosinophilia, so separation requires negative skin-prick or specific IgE testing rather than morphology.
Basophils and mast cells have dark blue-purple metachromatic granules rather than orange-pink eosinophilic granules.
